commands: echo "GITHUB_ACTIONS=${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-<unset>}"; echo "GITHUB_RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-<unset>}"; git branch --show-current; git status --porcelain | head; .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/config-get.sh base_branch 2>/dev/null || echo "no base config"

gh pr view 2037 --json number,body,title,headRefName --jq '{number,title}'; echo "===WORKPAD==="; WID=$(scripts/workpad.py id 2013 2>/dev/null || true); echo "WID=$WID"; if [ -n "$WID" ]; then scripts/workpad.py body "$WID" 2>/dev/null | grep -iE '\(post-merge\)' || echo "(no post-merge items)"; fi; echo "===DEFERRALS==="; ls -la .prflow/tmp/review/pr-2037/deferrals.json 2>/dev/null || echo "(no deferrals file)"
WID=$(scripts/workpad.py id 2013 2>/dev/null || true); echo "WID=$WID"; if [ -n "$WID" ]; then scripts/workpad.py body "$WID" 2>/dev/null | grep -in 'post-merge' || echo "no-post-merge"; fi

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
